title: Nonlinear Instability of Anti–de Sitter Spacetime
exact_target: Can sufficiently late black holes arise from vacuum anti-de Sitter perturbations of arbitrarily small size under reflecting boundary conditions?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003912 (OWR-16411-004). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 49.
Bizon--Rostworowski 2011 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: This target is the vacuum problem. Scalar-matter examples or resonant approximations, including IDs 30002150 and 30002920, are related mechanisms rather than proofs of the stated vacuum instability. The norm and boundary regularity must be specified in a theorem.
